## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Cleanup is idempotent across repeated close/archive
- dd-4: Cleanup events logged with ticket id and removed-path
- dd-5: Cleanup failures logged at WARN + structured per-ticket orphan marker file at `.tickets-tracker/.scratch-orphans/<id>` containing JSON `{ticket_id, path, error, timestamp}`; does NOT roll back status change

## Description

Add `_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket <ticket_id>` to plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh:
- Compute path=`<TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR>/.scratch/<id>`.
- If absent: emit INFO `scratch-cleanup ticket=<id> path=<path> result=absent`; return 0.
- Else `rm -rf -- "$path"`; on success emit INFO `result=removed`; return 0.
- On rm failure: emit WARN with id/path/error; write orphan marker JSON to `.tickets-tracker/.scratch-orphans/<id>` with keys `ticket_id`, `path`, `error`, `timestamp` (ISO-8601); return 0.
- Function MUST always return 0 — callers must not see cleanup failure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format (N/A)
- [ ] Helper defined in ticket-lib.sh
  Verify: bash -c 'source plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh && declare -F _scratch_cleanup_for_ticket' | grep -q _scratch_cleanup_for_ticket
- [ ] Helper returns 0 when target absent / writes orphan marker on failure / idempotent
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user; MAX_AGENTS=0 skips opus.
